t: This is Branch Hill, a street in Hampstead that runs beside the heath, between Frognal Rise and West Heath Road. It is named after a hill on Hampstead Heath. When this was still largely open countryside, it was a favourite landscape of John Constable, who painted it a number of times. Near the West Heath Road junction is Branch Hill Pond, which dried up in the early twentieth century, and recent efforts have been made to restore it. The barrister and antiquarian Richard Price died here in 1833.
